verdict.rationale: Unit documents sending and receiving money via ACH, building directly on its APIs, and a Webhook Events docs page, so basic API-driven ACH is claimed. Nothing in the evidence shows how ACH works in detail. missing for 10: explicit ACH credit vs debit origination, same-day ACH windows, returns/NOCs/reversals modeled as first-class API objects, ACH-specific webhook events, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can originate ACH through the API — credits and debits, same-day windows, and the unhappy paths (returns, NOCs, reversals) modeled as first-class objects with webhooks

citations.quote: Send and receive money using payment capabilities including ACH, wires, real-time payments, checks, and international payments
Companies can build directly on the Unit Platform using APIs and components
